SELECT w.id, w.name, w.cover, w.description, w.node_count, w.creator_id, w.status, w.view_count, w.created_at, w.updated_at, u.nickname AS creator_name FROM t_world_tree w LEFT JOIN t_user u ON w.creator_id = u.id
AND w.status = #{status} AND w.creator_id = #{creatorId}
AND (w.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR w.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY w.updated_at DESC, w.id DESC
